active_continuity: Hyuk Mujin is Vice Squad Leader of the Jin Dragon Squad under Wipeng and accompanied Jin Wikyung to Henan as his escort.
Taekyung has returned to Henan disguised as a beggar and reunited with Jin Wikyung and Hyuk Mujin.
Hocheol is a Jin Dragon Squad martial artist and a subordinate of Hyuk Mujin.
Cheongpung fled while being escorted to Huashan with the Three Plum Blossom Elites and is missing.
Jin Mukyung has remained in closed-door training for approximately one year and six months and refuses to leave before Great Completion.
Jang Taebo handed Hyuk Mujin a completed spear fifteen days earlier, and Wikyung presented it to Taekyung.
open_questions: Where has the Jin Family Head been during his years of unexplained absence?
When will Jin Mukyung achieve Great Completion and leave closed-door training?
Where did Cheongpung go after fleeing on the way to Huashan?
temporary_decisions: Use Vice Squad Leader for 부대주 and Jin Dragon Squad for 진룡대.
Use Gan Jiang and Mo Ye for 간장 and 막야.
Use Put your head on the ground for 대가리 박아 and Yes, sir! Yes, sir! for 존명존명.
